name: ui-hill-climb
description: Improves an existing app's appearance, usability and responsiveness over several bounded rounds without supervision. Use when asked to improve or polish a running app overnight, hill climb a UI, run a design or model review council on an app, or make an app look and feel better across rounds. Not for one known fix, designing a new flow (ui-design), diagnosing first load alone (web-perf), or a single design critique.
